units.source_text: 凡是乳母，往往偏爱她自己喂养大来的孩子，

en.t: A nurse is often especially fond of the child she has raised herself,

units.source_text: 即使这孩子有缺点，她也看成完美无缺的人。

en.t: and even if that child has faults, she sees him as perfectly flawless.

units.source_text: 何况这乳母喂养大来的是源氏公子这样高贵的美男子，

en.t: All the more so when the child this nurse had raised was a noble and beautiful young man like Lord Genji,

units.source_text: 她当然更加体面，觉得自己曾经朝夕服侍他，也很高贵，

en.t: so naturally she felt even more honored, and thought that having served him morning and night made her noble too,

units.source_text: 竟是前世修来的，因此眼泪流个不住。

en.t: as though it were merit earned in a former life; because of this, her tears would not stop flowing.

units.source_text: 乳母的子女们看见母亲这般光景，都不高兴。

en.t: When the nurse's children saw their mother in this state, they were all displeased.

units.source_text: 他们想：“做了尼姑还要留恋人世，

en.t: They thought, "Even after becoming a nun, she still clings to the world,

units.source_text: 啼啼哭哭的，教源氏公子看了多么难过！”

en.t: and with all this sobbing, how painful it must be for Lord Genji to see her!"

units.source_text: 便互相使眼色，交头接耳，表示不满。

en.t: So they exchanged looks, whispered among themselves, and showed their dissatisfaction.

units.source_text: 源氏公子深深体会乳母的心情，对她说：“我幼小时候疼爱我的人，

en.t: Lord Genji deeply understood his nurse's feelings and said to her, "The people who loved me when I was little,

units.source_text: 像母亲和外祖母，早已故世了，

en.t: such as my mother and my maternal grandmother, passed away long ago,

units.source_text: 后来抚养我的人很多，然而我所最亲爱的，

en.t: and later many people cared for me, but the one dearest to me,

units.source_text: 除了你妈妈之外没有别人了。

en.t: apart from you, mother, is no one else.

units.source_text: 我成人之后，为身份所拘，不能常常和你会面，

en.t: After I came of age, I was constrained by my rank and could not often meet with you,

units.source_text: 又不能随心所欲地来访。

en.t: nor could I visit whenever I wished.

units.source_text: 然而久不相见，便觉心情不快。

en.t: Yet when I go long without seeing you, my heart feels troubled.

units.source_text: 诚如古人所说：‘但愿人间无死别！’”

en.t: It is just as the people of old said: 'If only there were no parting by death in this world!'"

units.source_text: 他殷勤恳切地安慰她，不觉泪流满颊。

en.t: He comforted her with earnest tenderness, and before he knew it tears were streaming down his cheeks.

units.source_text: 举袖拭泪，衣香洋溢室中。

en.t: When he raised his sleeve to wipe his tears, the fragrance of his robes filled the room.

units.source_text: 乳母的子女们先前抱怨母亲啼啼哭哭，

en.t: The nurse's children, who had earlier complained about their mother's weeping,

units.source_text: 现在也都感动得掉下泪来，想道：“怪不得，

en.t: were now moved as well and shed tears, thinking, "No wonder,

units.source_text: 做这个人的乳母，的确与众不同，

en.t: being this man's nurse truly is something out of the ordinary,

units.source_text: 真是前世修来的啊！”

en.t: and it really must be merit earned in a former life!"
